notes.title: "Mosaique Neko Waifus 3" just released!
notes.content:
Ahh "Mosaique Neko Waifus". The forbidden pleasure...
Well not any longer!

The new one is out NOW! So grab a copy if this is your thing ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385730/Mosaique_Neko_Waifus_3/
What's new?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/130cb1dcb42cd74cc8b660d74fdb5a3b7e5cb2b7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/e9f505e8dc44510f06e9d81f6e097911d522ef28.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/bad349e0499b01c71eb811f50e6f59a39ca754ad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/353798730706e2b2013309f6ee72891717ed4ade.jpg[/img]

• 2 new girls: Coco and Luli.
• 2 new old girls: Sayouri and Niko
• 14 classic abilities that have not been changed much
• 4 new abilities: Love Axe, Laser Burst, Mirroring Edge, and Lazy Bomb. You will love the Lazy Bomb if you are a strategic player
• Ability stash! There is only a limited amount of ability slots so you need to manage which ones you want to be equipped
• If you want new ability slots you need to farm "Bubble Wraps" from talking to girls
• 16 SFW Puzzles
• 90 Items
• 100 Achievements

( I cannot say whether there is a FREE R18 Expansion or not! But you never know, life might surprise you )

notes.title: Update and a new DLC with girl images
notes.content:
"Hentai Mosaique Vip Room" got a small face lifting.

• Glow/Bloom in the game has been reduced so that everything is a bit more readable now
• 2 new music tracks added so that the music is more versatile

Also a new DLC with girl images!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111790/Hentai_Mosaique_Vip_Room_Arts_R18/

Someone asked for the images of girls extracted as graphical files. So here they go.
Who knows, maybe we'll be releasing this type of DLC on day one for every Hentai Mosaique game?

notes.title: 18+ DLC, More Abilities, Release date moved
notes.content:
• What fun is a hentai game without a R18 DLC? Hentai Mosaique Vip room will offer additional 10 puzzles in this free expansion.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652768/8a2c985e5bcabfae2fa81e998d916dc5e577c559.png[/img]
• 5 Abilities is fun, but 10 is much better. That's what we will be getting in the release.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652768/c3486ec4da308a0bb98dcfe0fa4a2e742610dd8b.png[/img]
• The game will be released on 10-th of April 2019. And that's final.
